Source-backed native R record schemas for 28 Python 1.2 workflow dataclasses

etr_frozen_workflow_schema.Rd

A Python-free, frozen-source description of 28 public Python workflow dataclasses and their 303 ordered declared fields. Native record containers preserve field names and values but do not reproduce Python's constructors, defaults, validation, immutability, scientific estimators, or result formats. They are not independent full-domain source parity certifications.

Usage

etr_frozen_workflow_schema(class_name = NULL)
etr_frozen_workflow_record(class_name, fields)
etr_native_workflow_result_view(result)

Arguments

class_name

One of the 28 frozen Python 1.2 public workflow dataclass names, or NULL when listing all source schemas.

fields

Uniquely named native R list supplying every declared source field explicitly, including fields with Python defaults. Entries may be NULL.

result

A native etr_fpca_workflow, etr_function_on_scalar_workflow, or etr_recurrence_workflow result already fitted in R. Recurrence views preserve three measured native step durations, not Python runtime measurements.

Value

etr_frozen_workflow_schema() returns the source-pinned field schema as a data frame. etr_frozen_workflow_record() returns a native etr_frozen_workflow_record S3 list in Python declaration field order, with explicit FALSE flags for source scientific and independent certification. etr_native_workflow_result_view() returns a field-ordered read-only conceptual view (not an immutable R object) of an existing native workflow.

Details

The manifest records Python annotations and default expressions as inert strings; it never evaluates Python source, runs external software, or automatically executes a workflow. Required-field and default semantics are descriptive only. The class source commit is c1cd95ad718327550f7e55393ff38582872f7a94.

Examples

schema <- etr_frozen_workflow_schema("ScoreUncertaintyConfig")
record <- etr_frozen_workflow_record("ScoreUncertaintyConfig",
  list(condition_limit = NULL, failure_action = "error"))
stopifnot(identical(names(record), schema$field_name))
